card.name: BC after ancient year numbers
card.fires_on: The letters BC right after a number giving an ancient year, such as 5000 or 6000, in history or mythology text. Weaker on a few other number-word spots.

modes.label: BC after a year
modes.description: The era marker BC follows a round ancient year number.

modes.label: Other number spots
modes.description: Occasional hits inside a number or a numeric title, not tied to BC.

card.plain: It lights up on the era label BC when it follows an ancient year like 5000 BC.
